meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 装上后，一旦检测到经典的单一机器人 Slack 安装，Claude 会先给你选择：迁移成每个智能体群组一个专属应用，或继续用旧模式。若选迁移，它会逐个开通专属应用，保留原有身份、工作区、记忆和对话方式，并在你确认前保留旧配置以便回滚。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示要处理 Slack agents 要求时触发，或之后随时手动运行；检测到尚未迁移的经典 Slack 状态时，它会先让你选择迁移或留在经典模式。

say.text: 把经典 Slack 机器人迁移成每个智能体群组一个专属应用。
say.note: 开始盘点并展示映射表让你确认。

say.text: 我想留在经典 Slack 模式，不迁移。
say.note: 记录选择且不改动现有配置。

say.text: 继续上次未完成的 Slack 迁移。
say.note: 从保存的迁移记录处继续。

howto.what_en: Detects classic single-bot Slack; offers per-agent-group apps or staying classic. If migrating, provisions apps preserving identities/memory/wiring; old config retained for rollback until cutover approval.
howto.when_en: Use when /update-nanoclaw raises the Slack agents requirement, or standalone later. Also prompts when classic Slack state is detected but not yet migrated, to choose migration or staying classic.

say_en.text: Migrate our classic Slack bot into one app per agent group.
say_en.note: Starts inventory and shows the mapping for your confirmation.

say_en.text: I want to stay on classic Slack; do not migrate.
say_en.note: Records choice and keeps setup unchanged.

say_en.text: Resume the previous unfinished Slack migration.
say_en.note: Continues from the saved migration ledger.
